totals.title: All reported accidents
totals.definition: All-road state totals; fatalities count people, not crashes.

users.title: Victim road users
users.definition: Fatalities classified by victim road-user category. No accident denominator.
users.note: Existing verified extracts; see source registry. Kerala road-user attribution changed in 2023.

violations.title: Reported traffic violations
violations.definition: Reported attribution, not proof of causation.

roads.title: Road classes
roads.definition: National highways including expressways, state highways and other roads.

outcomes.title: Crash injury outcomes
outcomes.definition: Crash events classified by outcome. Fatal crashes are different from people killed.

collisions.title: Collision types
collisions.definition: Source-reported collision classification; categories are not causal effects.

vehicles.title: Reported impacting vehicles / objects
vehicles.definition: Annexure 26 classification, distinct from victim-user fatalities in Annexure 29.
vehicles.note: Preserve source anomalies: Kerala bicycles reports 2 accidents and 88 deaths. Do not interpret category severity before investigating definitions/reporting. Vehicle severity is disabled.

weather.title: Weather conditions
weather.definition: Reported weather marginals, not joinable to time/vehicle categories.

features.title: Road features
features.definition: Reported road features, not precise locations.

junctions.title: Junction types
junctions.definition: Reported junction categories; no specific junction coordinates.
junctions.note: Junction-related crashes only; this is not the all-road universe.

controls.title: Traffic controls
controls.note: Traffic-control classifications cover reported junction-related crashes, not all-road totals.

urban.title: Urban and rural
urban.definition: All-road urban/rural counts, not a cross-filter for other marginal datasets.

months.title: Monthly accidents
months.definition: State × year × month; not jointly classified with vehicle/weather.

hours.title: Time of occurrence
hours.definition: Reported 3-hour bands and unknown time; accident counts only.

matrix.title: Victim / impacting-vehicle matrix
matrix.definition: Fatalities in jointly reported victim × opponent categories; not all victim groups are supplied.
matrix.note: Pedestrian total is 35,203 here versus 35,221 in Annexure 29. Kerala differs by 18; preserve both source totals pending reconciliation.

demographics.title: Victim age and reported sex
demographics.definition: Persons killed by reported age band and sex. Source age-band labels are preserved; these are not vehicle-specific rates.

states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
